answer_1.quote: Recent research has made solid strides towards gauging and improving performance of open-domain conversational agents ...

answer_2.quote: For automated metrics, we report hits@1 on the test set (or validation set in the case of ConvAI2 ...), out of 20 candidates for ConvAI2, and 100 candidates for ED and WoW, following the original datasets.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we ask workers to chat with various models and then rate the conversation along several axes: • Knowledge: ... • Empathy: ... • Personal: ... • Overall: ...
answer_4.guideline: Workers rate each conversation on the axes of Knowledge, Empathy, Personal, and Overall using a 1‑5 Likert scale.
